output: html_document

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
df <- read.csv("C://Users//Nick//Desktop//KSurvey3.1.21.csv")
```
```{r}

df1 <- df[, 39:60]
co <- cor(df1, use="complete.obs")
corrplot::corrplot(co)

```
```{r}


png(file="Aim1BarriersPlot.png",
width=1000, height=1000)
df1 <- df[, 39:60]
co <- cor(df1, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
testRes = cor.mtest(df1, conf.level = 0.95)
corrplot::corrplot(co, p.mat = testRes$p, method = 'number', diag = FALSE, type = 'upper', insig = 'blank')
dev.off()
```
